## 中文

- 修复 macOS 首次打开菜单栏弹窗时账号列表不显示，以及从管理账号或设置返回后主页高度不一致的问题。
- 主页高度随账号数量调整，最多完整显示 3 个账号；更多账号上下滚动查看，预测栏和底部操作保持可见。

macOS 和 Windows 共享 v0.1.18 版本；本次行为修复仅涉及 macOS。macOS Apple Silicon DMG 经过 Developer ID 签名和 Apple 公证，Windows x64 EXE 为自包含应用，仍未签名。

## English

- Fix the macOS account list collapsing on first open and the home height changing after returning from Manage Accounts or Settings.
- Size the home page to its accounts, showing up to three complete rows. Additional accounts scroll while the forecast and footer remain visible.

macOS and Windows share v0.1.18; this behavior change applies to macOS. The macOS Apple Silicon DMG is Developer ID signed and Apple notarized. The Windows x64 EXE is self-contained and remains unsigned.
